Text Encoding Initiative

The XML Version of the TEI Guidelines

<class>

<class> specifies the name of an element class.
Attributes Global attributes only
Example 
<classDoc>
 <class>phrase</class>
    <!-- ... -->
</classDoc>
Module Declared in file teitsd2; Auxiliary DTD for Tag Set documentation
Data Description In TEI compatible encoding systems, the class name should be chosen so that a valid entity name may be made from it. For attribute classes, this name is made by prefixing the class name with the string ‘a.’; for model classes, the string ‘m.’ is used.
May contain #PCDATA
May occur within
Declaration 
<!ELEMENT class %om.RO; (#PCDATA)> 
<!ATTLIST class  
      %a.global;>
See further 27.2 Element Classes
